viewing_check: Photograph the incised mark on the back of the head (maker, mould number, size, e.g. 'A 5 M' or 'S&H'). Check the head for hairline cracks with a torch from inside if the wig/pate lifts, and chips at rim and eye sockets. Check the body stamp, joints and fit of limbs, and doll height. Note any original clothing or label.
